title: Conduction is heat moving between two solids that touch
summary: Conduction is the transfer of heat between two solid objects that are touching.
body: NASA's insulator guide defines conduction as the transfer of heat between two solid objects that are touching. The background paragraph says the same thing in other words: when heat moves between two solids that are touching, it is called conduction. This card is only the touching-solids case. It does not name which solid carries heat fastest.

sources.title: NASA's Our World: Insulators, educator guide EG-2010-06-008-LaRC
sources.author: NASA
sources.note: NASA eClips educator guide, U.S. government work, public domain. Product code dated June 2010. Supports conduction as heat transfer between two solid objects that are touching.
